abstract: OBJECTIVES: To determine the pathologic findings and clinical outcome of patients with pure teratoma of the testis who underwent primary or postchemotherapy retroperitoneal lymphadenectomy (RPLND). METHODS: From January 1989 to February 1998, 29 patients with pure testicular teratoma underwent primary (n = 11) or postchemotherapy (n = 18) RPLND. RESULTS: Overall, 23 (79%) of 29 patients had retroperitoneal disease, with 18 (62%) initially presenting with advanced disease. The pathologic stage in the 11 patients undergoing primary RPLND was pN0 in 6 (55%), pN1 in 3 (27%), and pN2 in 2 (18%). Of the 7 patients with clinical Stage I undergoing primary RPLND, 1 had teratoma and 1 had seminoma in the retroperitoneum; of the 4 patients with clinical Stage IIA, 2 had teratoma and 1 had embryonal carcinoma. Four patients were lost to follow-up and the other seven had no evidence of disease (NED) at a median follow-up of 90.4 months, with no relapses. The pathologic findings in the 18 patients undergoing postchemotherapy RPLND revealed fibrosis in 8, teratoma in 9, and yolk sac tumor in 1. At last follow-up, 7 of the 9 patients with teratoma were NED, 1 was dead of disease, and 1 was dead of unknown causes. Of the 8 patients with fibrosis, 6 had NED and 2 were lost to follow-up. The patient with viable cancer had NED at last follow-up. CONCLUSIONS: These data underscore the metastatic potential of pure testicular teratoma. A significant proportion (45%) of patients with low-stage pure testicular teratoma had retroperitoneal disease. Furthermore, a high proportion (62%) presented initially with advanced disease and demonstrated a considerable risk of relapse despite complete resection or favorable histologic features in the resected retroperitoneal specimen.
abstract_ja: 目的：初回または化学療法後の後腹膜リンパ節郭清（RPLND）を受けた純粋精巣奇形腫患者の病理所見と臨床経過を明らかにすること。方法：1989年1月から1998年2月の間に、純粋精巣奇形腫の患者29例が初回（11例）または化学療法後（18例）のRPLNDを受けた。結果：29例中23例（79%）が後腹膜病変を有し、18例（62%）は進行病期で初診した。初回RPLNDを受けた11例の病理病期は、pN0が6例（55%）、pN1が3例（27%）、pN2が2例（18%）であった。初回RPLNDを受けた臨床病期Iの7例中、1例は後腹膜に奇形腫、1例は後腹膜にセミノーマがみられた。臨床病期IIAの4例中、2例は奇形腫、1例は胎児性癌であった。化学療法後RPLNDを受けた18例の病理所見は、線維化8例、奇形腫9例、卵黄嚢腫瘍1例であった。最終フォローアップ時、奇形腫の9例中7例は無病生存（NED）、1例は原病死、1例は原因不明の死亡であった。線維化の8例中6例はNED、2例はフォローアップ喪失となった。生存腫瘍の患者は最終フォローアップ時にNEDであった。結論：これらのデータは、純粋精巣奇形腫の転移能の高さを裏付けるものである。病期の低い純粋精巣奇形腫患者の相当な割合（45%）が後腹膜病変を有していた。さらに、高い割合（62%）が進行病期で初診し、完全切除や切除された後腹膜検体の良好な組織学的特徴があっても、再発リスクが相当高いことが示された。
